$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: Accordion
import: import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from '@theya/shadcn/ui/accordion';
whenToUse: Several sections people scan by heading and open one or two of: FAQs, settings groups, long details.

whenNotToUse.instead: show it — don’t hide the main path

anatomy.description: the section heading as a button, chevron on the right.

do.caption: Questions people scan; they open the one they care about.

dont.caption: Required checkout steps hidden in an accordion: people miss the closed ones.
dont.example:
<Accordion type="single" collapsible className="w-full">
  <AccordionItem value="plan"><AccordionTrigger>Choose a plan</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Starter, Pro, Business…</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="pay"><AccordionTrigger>Payment details</AccordionTrigger><AccordionContent>Card number, expiry…</AccordionContent></AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

a11y: Triggers are buttons inside headings, with aria-expanded; Enter/Space toggles, ↑/↓ move between triggers.
Keep headings short — they are read as a list of questions.
